releases.displayName: New hotfix for Fernbus Simulator now available!

items.text: The new hotfix for Fernbus Simulator on PC is now available! As announced in our preview, it addresses numerous issues in the England DLC, improves AI traffic and fixes various bus functions. The hotfix also includes further corrections to the game world, controls and graphics.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/ecca31af4e2226ddcd14d0a01cf6011b2f024398.png"]

notes.title: Fixes for England and AI traffic

items.text: We have corrected lane configurations in England that were confusing AI traffic in some locations. AI vehicles now also check further behind them before changing lanes.

The traffic mix has been adjusted as well: London-specific AI vehicles have been added, while the number of police cars in England has been reduced. Police vehicles from other countries should also no longer appear in the wrong locations.

Further fixes address AI driver seating positions, incorrect licence plates and the indicators on some AI vehicles. We have also resolved an issue where the player’s bus could prevent AI buses from spawning, along with a crash when driving into Oxford.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/6e29727a389fea7d6ce8980c60ba1d969744c2a7.png"]

For buses, one focus has been cameras and lighting. We have fixed the door action cameras and camera brightness in the Tourism W410, as well as passenger lighting in several buses. The driver lights in the Neoplan Skyliner and Scania Interlink have also been corrected.

Other changes affect ventilation animations and controls: ComfortClass buttons no longer activate twice, and the game now pauses correctly when refuelling. In Arcade mode, we have fixed issues with the engine not turning off when leaving the vehicle and the luggage door not opening at the start.
Ferry crossings and train journeys now count as breaks when evaluating your trip. A message also appears when FlixBus announcements cannot play due to the selected game mode.

Alongside these changes, we have addressed issues with Photo Mode, fog and signs. Missing repaints and sound options are available again. We have also fixed FSR issues, updated DLSS and resolved crashes when switching routes or starting the game with Multi-Display.
Thank you for your bug reports and feedback! You can find the full changelog below.

Hello everyone,
Update 35 for Fernbus Simulator is now available!
The highlight of this update is the upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.6, bringing Fernbus Simulator to a more up-to-date technical foundation. As part of the upgrade, FSR and DLSS have also been updated.

The update also introduces a new sky and weather system. Vehicle friction is now affected by the surface and current weather conditions. Traction control as well as the ABS and ASR systems for buses have also been updated. Further improvements include gamepad controls, Photo Mode, mirrors and the interaction between wheels and curbs.
Fernbus Simulator also receives the new city of Bremerhaven, including a bus stop, which is added free of charge for all players with Update 35.
The England DLC and the Tourism W410 have also been released for Fernbus Simulator alongside Update 35. Both DLCs are available separately or together as a bundle.
To celebrate the release, you can watch the England DLC Release Trailer here:

items.text: There's another BETA update for Fernbus Simulator available for you!
For the full detailed list of changes, please, see the changelog below.
Please create backup copies of your savegame files before switching to the BETA Update. Savegames may not be compatible with the new version of the game.
ATTENTION: This is a BETA update. Technical problems, instability of the game as well as bugs during gameplay can be possible.
How to install the beta version of the update?
In your Library, you click with the right mouse button on the entry of the "Fernbus Simulator"
In the drop-menu, you click on the entry "Properties"
In the window "Fernbus Simulator - Properties" you select the tab "BETAS"
In the field "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" select the entry "beta-beta"
Now you can close the window and the beta version of the update should download right away
After downloading the update you can start Fernbus Simulator via the "PLAY" button
In the main menu should now be the corresponding version number of the beta version of the update and you can test the update
